description: For every leaf input of every engine: what happens when the input arrives as 'unresolved'. 'block' = no verdict can be produced (UI shows the distinct 'cannot be determined' state). 'fallback' = a named, conservative value is substituted AND a caveat is attached to the result. Model-inferred values are never an allowed provenance.

release_hint.doc: runReleaseAI() - 9 keyword rules (first match wins) preceded by the >=4 delivery-model complexity check.

name.rationale: Without a name there is nothing to scan; 'no hint' would read as 'checked and clear'.

notes.rationale: Standard form treats blank notes as '' and scans name only. Allowed ONLY with a mandatory caveat so the user knows notes were not scanned.

deliveryModels.rationale: Blank selection is the form default, but the >=4 delivery-model complexity check would be silently skipped - caveat is mandatory.

defect_hint.doc: runDefectAI() - 8 keyword rules over the defect title (first match wins). In the standard form it also overwrites the severity and classification fields; in the agent path those are shown as SUGGESTIONS only.

title.rationale: Engine shows nothing without a title; that must not read as 'no issue found'.

readiness.doc: calculateReadiness() - score = gates*0.40 + defects*0.30 + envs*0.20 + signoffs*0.10 (rounded). No Go/No-Go threshold exists; colour bands (75/50) are display only.

gates[].id.rationale: Cannot place a gate in the gate set.

gates[].status.rationale: Conservative: only passed/waived add to the score, and 'not-started' is the form default at gate creation.

gates[].signedBy.rationale: Conservative: a blank sign-off lowers the sign-off component, matching the form default.

gates.rationale: Legacy engine returns 50/100 for a release with zero gates (defects+environments still score) and 0/0 sign-offs - an artefact, not a verdict. The agent path refuses to produce it.

defects.rationale: If the defect list is unknown the 30% defect component cannot be computed; defaulting to 'no defects' would score a possibly-blocked release as clear.

defects[].releaseId.rationale: A defect that cannot be attributed to a release cannot be included or excluded safely.

defects[].classification.rationale: NOT conservative to default: an unresolved defect defaulted to non-blocker could hide a release blocker (30% of the score). Hard block.

envPath.rationale: Legacy engine divides by envPath.length: an empty path yields NaN. The agent path refuses to produce it.

environments.rationale: Conservative: an environment with no health reading scores exactly like 'unknown' (not healthy).

environments[].env.rationale: Cannot place a health reading in the path.

environments[].health.rationale: Conservative: 'unknown' is the form default and scores as not healthy, exactly like warning/blocked.

gate_hint.doc: getGateReadinessHint() - up to 5 conditional hints per gate.

gateId.rationale: Hints depend on which gate this is.

entryConfirmed.rationale: Conservative: the hint then says criteria are not yet confirmed, which prompts the user to check.

blockerCount.rationale: The Go/No-Go blocker hint depends on it, and a defaulted 0 would suppress a warning.

preProdVersion.rationale: Hint is skipped (not asserted either way); caveat tells the user the comparison was not made.

deliveryModels.rationale: Mobile store-approval hint skipped; caveat required.

risk_score.doc: Risk score = likelihood x impact. High >= 15, medium >= 8, otherwise low. Open risks scoring >= 15 are counted in Go/No-Go wizard step 4.

likelihood.rationale: No neutral value exists; any default would invent a score.

impact.rationale: No neutral value exists; any default would invent a score.

decision_record.doc: recordGNGDecision() - RECORDS a human GO / NO-GO. It computes nothing. The agent layer may never supply or imply 'decision' (Constraints doc Sections 2-3, 8).

decision.rationale: The GO / NO-GO is a human decision. The agent can never supply it, only present the evidence.

decidedBy.rationale: A recorded decision without an accountable person is not valid.

rationale.rationale: Optional narrative; blank is allowed by the standard form.

riskNotes.rationale: Optional narrative; blank is allowed by the standard form.
